description: This file defines the Amazon Machine Learning client class for AWS SDK for PHP. It provides methods to interact with AWS Machine Learning services, including creating, deleting, and describing resources, as well as a custom endpoint modification related to the 'Predict' operation.
external_methods: ... (many AWS SDK and Guzzle methods listed in doc comments)

classes.name: MachineLearningClient
classes.description: An AWS SDK client class for Amazon Machine Learning service, extending AwsClient, with additional logic for customizing the 'Predict' endpoint requests via a middleware.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the client with provided configuration and appends a custom middleware to modify the 'Predict' endpoint.

methods.name: predictEndpoint
methods.description: Private method returning a middleware that intercepts 'Predict' commands to modify the request URI to a custom endpoint.
